name: Omar Sharaf
headline: Director of Data Engineering · AI/ML & MLOps
summary: Director of Data Engineering with 7+ years in data engineering and AI/ML at Fortune 100 companies. Leads four engineering teams (8 direct reports, 10 offshore engineers) that ship production Generative AI (RAG) and machine-learning systems, and doubled ML model deployments in one year through reusable MLOps architecture. AWS certified; completing an M.S. in Data Science.
